title: Niagara Nautico
specs: She has cabins for changing, cooking facilities, a washroom with a shower, a swim deck with another shower, a bluetooth sound system, and ample room above and below decks for your party to relax.
Each passenger under the age of 18 must be accompanied by an adult; one adult per child guest.
If you’d like to swim, bring a suit and a towel.
For each child under 12 your booking must include an adult 18 or older.
You may bring alcohol, but we aren’t a booze cruise.

services.name: Full Sailing Experience
services.desc: 3 Hours About A charter includes 3 hours on the water, leaving from Port Dalhousie. We can either sail up the beautiful Niagara coastline, or drop anchor off Dalhousie Beach. All charters come with charcuterie cups and sparkling water, and we have a variety of upgrades available. Black Diamond is fully equipped for your comfort. She has cabins for changing, cooking facilities, a washroom with a shower, a swim deck with another shower, a bluetooth sound system, and ample room above and below decks for your party to relax. We've sailed the Caribbean and are bringing that cruising All ages • 3 Hours • Up to 8 People

services.name: Weddings on the Water
services.desc: 3 hours of sailing, whole day with the boat About Our Nautico wedding packages include everything you need to be legally and joyfully married in a ceremony that you will never forget. Packages include your Officiant (Captain Russ, recognized by the Province of Ontario), professional photography, 3 hours of sailing, catering for all on board, and simple decorations.
